The supplied source shows no destination ownership or write-permission check on this path; the separately declared _validate_collection_access helper is not invoked by process_file in the supplied entry path, and its shown default is read access rather than a demonstrated write check. save_docs_to_vector_db checks whether the collection exists and ultimately calls VECTOR_DB_CLIENT.insert(collection_name=collection_name, items=items), which is the destination write sink.
